group.name: Unified Multimodal Generative Modeling
group.definition: 텍스트·이미지·영상·오디오·행동·구조화 데이터를 서로 분리된 입력으로 처리할 때 생기는 표현 불일치와 생성·지각 간 단절을 줄이기 위해, 여러 모달리티를 공유 토큰 공간이나 통합 트랜스포머·확산 구조에서 공동 모델링하는 기술이다. 주요 방식은 모달리티를 이산 토큰으로 변환해 동일한 예측 절차를 적용하거나, 자기회귀 예측·확산·flow·MoE를 결합하고 조건·대상을 함께 학습해 생성과 이해를 연결하는 것이다. 다만 이 그룹에는 순수 speculative decoding, 단일 영상의 4D 변환, 확산 모델의 RL 안정화처럼 공통 멀티모달 통합 원리와 직접 겹치지 않는 항목도 포함되어 있어 하나의 좁은 기술로 해석할 수 없다.
group.evidence_summary: 그룹의 많은 claim은 텍스트·이미지·영상·오디오·행동을 서로 다른 처리 경로에 두는 대신 공유 이산 토큰, 단일 스트림, 공동 조건-대상 모델 또는 통합 MoE로 다루려는 방향을 보여준다. 반복되는 문제는 모달리티별 표현 공간과 데이터 규모가 다르고, 생성 결과의 시간·공간 일관성과 지각 근거를 동시에 유지하기 어렵다는 점이다. 확산 모델은 병렬적·반복적 생성으로, 자기회귀 모델은 순차 예측으로, 하이브리드 구조는 두 방식의 장점을 결합하는 방식으로 이 문제에 접근한다. 그러나 20개 claim 전체에는 추론 가속, 4D 변환, 확산 RL 안정화처럼 이 공통 원리에서 벗어난 인접 기술도 함께 들어 있다.
group.why_emerging: 멀티모달 시스템이 텍스트뿐 아니라 영상 프레임, 오디오, 이미지·레이아웃, 행동과 구조화 데이터까지 처리해야 하면서 모달리티별 표현과 확장 비용의 차이가 커지고 있다. 긴 시퀀스와 고해상도 입력에서는 자기회귀 생성의 순차 비용, 확산 모델의 반복 디노이징 비용, 여러 모달리티 사이의 정렬 오류가 동시에 발생한다. 이에 따라 공유 토큰 공간, 하이브리드 예측·확산, MoE, 단일 스트림과 같은 통합 설계가 제안되고 있다. 다만 제공된 그룹 자체가 여러 인접 문제를 포함하므로, 모든 claim에 공통적인 단일 병목이나 하나의 성숙한 기술 계층이 확인된다고 보기는 어렵다.

evaluation.scenario: 카카오뱅크 AI는 금융 질의·거래 데이터·표 형태의 계좌 및 소비 정보·이미지 등을 함께 처리하는 멀티모달 금융 비서로 확장할 수 있다. 예를 들어 AI 목표적금과 결제홈에서 거래·시계열 데이터를 분석해 개인화된 저축·소비 가이드를 생성하고, AI 초대장처럼 텍스트와 이미지를 함께 생성하는 서비스에도 활용할 수 있다.

sources.title: ICLR 2026 Workshop on Multimodal Intelligence: Next Token Prediction and Beyond

claims.name: Multimodal Next-X Prediction Across Tokens, Frames, and Scales
claims.evidence: A growing body of work now frames this progress under the unifying paradigm of next-X prediction, where X may denote tokens, frames, or scales across discrete or continuous spaces.

claims.name: Discrete Diffusion for Parallel Multimodal Generation
claims.evidence: Complementary to both, discrete diffusion models such as Diffusion-LM, LLaDA, and LaViDa redefine generation as iterative denoising, offering parallelism and improved global consistency.

claims.name: Hybrid Multimodal Models Combining Prediction and Diffusion
claims.evidence: Key questions include: Which learning paradigm scales most effectively? How do they differ in representation quality, efficiency, and controllability? And can hybrid models combine their strengths?

sources.title: 2nd ICML Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data

claims.name: Multimodal Tabular-Time-Series Foundation Models
claims.evidence: A particular focus in 2026 is on multimodal structured foundation models, which integrate tabular and time-series data with complementary modalities such as text and images, enabling richer supervision, improved generalization, and new capabilities beyond unimodal structured learning.

sources.title: Beyond Language Modeling: An Exploration of Multimodal Pretraining

claims.name: MoE for Scaling Unified Multimodal Models
claims.evidence: We demonstrate that the MoE architecture harmonizes this scaling asymmetry by providing the high model capacity required by language while accommodating the data-intensive nature of vision, paving the way for truly unified multimodal models.

sources.title: Beyond Next Token Prediction: Diffusion and Flow Models for Next-Generation Decoding

claims.name: Discrete Diffusion for Parallel Language Generation
claims.evidence: That shift brings a different set of computational properties — non-causal, parallel, and controllable — along with open questions spanning mathematics, algorithms, and engineering, and a growing body of work that combines the two paradigms rather than choosing between them.

sources.title: Beyond Pixels: From Video Priors to 4D Worlds

claims.name: Direct Video-Latent-to-4D Generation
claims.evidence: Trained on roughly 1K existing reconstruction clips, a single checkpoint transfers unchanged across multiple video diffusion transformers within the same VAE family.

sources.title: DiffusionART: Efficient, Stable and Scalable Reinforcement of Diffusion Models

claims.name: Reward-Aggregated State Updates for Stable Diffusion RL
claims.evidence: We introduce DiffusionART (Diffusion Reinforcement with Aggregation-First Reward Tilting), which aggregates each prompt's rewards into a shared reward-improving direction for reverse-process states, removing the consistency force by construction, and adds a trust-region-masked second update for drift-adaptive restoration without EMA tuning.

sources.title: Domino: Decoupling Causal Modeling from Autoregressive Drafting in Speculative Decoding

claims.name: Causally Refined Parallel Drafting for Speculative Decoding
claims.evidence: Domino first uses a parallel draft backbone to produce preliminary draft distributions for the entire block, and then applies a lightweight Domino head to refine them with prefix-dependent causal information.

sources.title: HY-Embodied-0.5: Embodied Foundation Models for Real-World Agents

claims.name: Mixture-of-Transformers for Fine-Grained Embodied Visual Perception
claims.evidence: To support the fine-grained visual perception essential for embodied tasks, we adopt a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture to enable modality-specific computing.

sources.title: LLaDA2.0-Uni: Unifying Multimodal Understanding and Generation with Diffusion Large Language Model

claims.name: Unified Multimodal Discrete Diffusion Models
claims.evidence: Its native support for interleaved generation and reasoning establishes a promising and scalable paradigm for next-generation unified foundation models.

sources.title: LongCat-Next: Lexicalizing Modalities as Discrete Tokens

claims.name: Shared-Discrete Multimodal Autoregressive Modeling
claims.evidence: To transcend this limitation, we introduce Discrete Native Autoregressive (DiNA), a unified framework that represents multimodal information within a shared discrete space, enabling a consistent and principled autoregressive modeling across modalities.

sources.title: OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding

claims.name: Omni-Modal Video Grounding with Joint Audio-Visual Evidence
claims.evidence: Precise temporal and spatial grounding remains challenging even for leading models, and their predictions still exhibit inconsistencies across the paired target specifications.

sources.title: Qianfan-OCR: A Unified End-to-End Model for Document Intelligence

claims.name: Layout-as-Thought for End-to-End Document OCR
claims.evidence: To address the loss of explicit layout analysis in end-to-end OCR, we propose Layout-as-Thought, an optional thinking phase triggered by special think tokens that generates structured layout representations -- bounding boxes, element types, and reading order -- before producing final outputs, recovering layout grounding capabilities while improving accuracy on complex layouts.

claims.name: Joint Condition-Target Multimodal Diffusion for Image Generation and Editing
claims.evidence: Qwen-Image-2.0 addresses these challenges by coupling Qwen3-VL as the condition encoder with a Multimodal Diffusion Transformer for joint condition-target modeling, supported by large-scale data curation and a customized multi-stage training pipeline.

sources.title: Robot Learning with World Models: Capabilities, Frontiers, and Challenges

claims.name: World Action Models for Robot Control
claims.evidence: Furthermore, integrating spatiotemporal physical dynamics into control policies (World Action Models) has led to the emergence of zero-shot and visuomotor control policies (e.g., DreamZero , Cosmos Policy ).

sources.title: Speed by Simplicity: A Single-Stream Architecture for Fast Audio-Video Generative Foundation Model

claims.name: Single-Stream Audio-Video Transformers
claims.evidence: This single-stream design avoids the complexity of multi-stream or cross-attention architectures while remaining easy to optimize with standard training and inference infrastructure.

sources.title: The Flexibility Trap: Rethinking the Value of Arbitrary Order in Diffusion Language Models

claims.name: Fixed-Order GRPO for Diffusion Language Models
claims.evidence: This observation motivates a rethink of RL approaches for dLLMs, where considerable complexities, such as handling combinatorial trajectories and intractable likelihoods, are often devoted to preserving this flexibility.

sources.title: Workshop on Document Intelligence and Understanding (DocInsights)

claims.name: Joint Text-Layout-Vision Document Modeling
claims.evidence: Documents are structured visual-textual evidence, not just plain text.

sources.title: World-R1: Reinforcing 3D Constraints for Text-to-Video Generation

claims.name: Flow-GRPO for 3D-Consistent Video Generation
claims.evidence: Extensive evaluations reveal that our approach significantly enhances 3D consistency while preserving the original visual quality of the foundation model, effectively bridging the gap between video generation and scalable world simulation.
